title: Edinburgh Research Summit ops jotter
content:
Quick ops jotter for Edinburgh Research Summit (user-facing notes + admin reminders)

Purpose: capture logistics, quick vendor contacts, expense rules, unresolved Qs. This is my single-file pocket log while traveling — terse, often messy.

TRIP BASICS
- Dates on-site: 2025-10-05 (arrive PM) -> 2025-10-09 (depart early AM)
- Flight (booked): BA1921 LHR-EDI arr 18:40 (hold baggage 2x)
- Return: BA1934 EDI-LHR 06:15 depart —— need pre-check at 04:00 (confirm with ops)
- Hotel: The Balmoral (booked under Redwood events block) — check-in 15:00, checkout 11:00
- Local timezone: BST (GMT+1)

ON-SITE CONTACTS
- On-site lead: Jordan Kim — mobile +44 7700 900123 — primary for day-of decisions
- Venue contact: St Cecilia Hall — events manager Niamh O'Connell +44 131 555 0123 (ask for loading dock window)
- AV vendor (local): NorthStar AV — ops@northstar-av.co.uk / +44 131 555 0222 — quote ref: NS-EDN-0925
- Furniture rental: Highland Rentals — contact Claire Munro +44 131 555 0303 — delivery 10/05 07:30
- Catering: Grassmarket Catering (boxed lunches + tea station) — dietary form link in Confluence
- Local taxi/contact for odd pickups: Edinburgh Couriers — +44 131 555 0444 (small van, 4 pax)

BOOTH & TECH NOTES
- Booth footprint: 3m x 2m. Backdrop hanging requires 2 people — bring small hammer & velcro kit.
- Power: 1 x 16A single phase dedicated line requested. Need power adapters: 2x UK 3-pin -> EU->UK adapter? (confirm count)
- Demo gear: 2 laptops, 1 Mac mini, 1 router (T-Mobile hotspot), 1 4K monitor, travel UPS (small)
- Shipping inbound: pallet arrives 10/04 to venue dock — vendor will hold until 10/05 morning, tracking: HDL-33121
- AV checklist: mic lav spare battery, 2x HDMI cables, backup adapter (USB-C -> HDMI), surge protector, extension lead 5m

RECEIPTS + EXPENSES (FOR REIMBURSEMENT)
- Policy quick: use Concur (company standard). Submit within 10 business days after trip.
- Required: itemized merchant receipt for meals, VAT invoices for rental/freight, boarding passes (attach PDFs), hotel folio.
- Personal card use: capture full receipt + statement showing card charge.
- Preferred naming convention for digital receipts: edn-YYYYMMDD-merchant-amount (e.g., edn-20251005-grassmarket-245.60GBP)
- Per-diem: not automatic — meals reimbursed actuals up to policy caps (confirm cap for UK city)
- VAT reclaim: UK VAT only reclaimable if vendor provides invoice with VAT registration. For furniture/chairs make sure rental invoice includes VAT number. Save hard copy receipts in pouch.
- Currency: expenses in GBP. Finance will convert in Concur; add exchange rate note if offline card used.

CARD AND PAYMENT NOTES
- Company card: primary card is with Priya Desai. For last-minute bookings use Redwood travel card (ask Priya).
- Small local purchases (taxi, coffee) — keep receipt, note purpose in Concur comment ("taxi: airport->hotel")

VENDOR TASK LIST (TO CONFIRM)
- [ ] NorthStar AV: confirm console operator arrival time + test slot 08:00 10/05
- [ ] Highland Rentals: confirm chair count 12 + extra high table
- [ ] Venue: confirm loading dock window 07:00-09:00 and forklift availability
- [ ] Catering: finalize dietary forms by 10/01 (send link reminder to Jordan)
- [ ] Courier: book small van for demo pickup 10/06 18:30

MEETING TIMELINE (day-of condensed)
- 07:00 venue open / load-in begins
- 08:00 AV techs test / network check (ensure demo router handing off to NAT)
- 09:30 speaker soundcheck / mic run-through
- 10:00 doors open / registration desk staffed (2 people)
- 12:30 boxed lunch delivered to green room
- 15:00 panel ends -> quick teardown planning (pack demo gear to courier)

PACKING CHECKLIST (essentials only)
- Travel: passport, wallet, company card, travel insurance printout, boarding pass PDFs saved offline
- Tech: 2x chargers, 2x dongles (USB-C->HDMI), ethernet cable, small travel router, power strip, cable ties
- Admin: pre-filled expense forms, printed voucher for hotel block, spare UK coins (for parking meters)

UNRESOLVED / QUESTIONS TO FOLLOW UP
- Do we need a temporary network passthrough approval for demo router? (IT security)
- Confirm whether venue requires a copy of the public liability certificate for Redwood — ask Jordan to request from venue
- Is there a signed SOW for NorthStar AV? if not, need PO before they deploy on-site.
- Chair rental: are floor gliders needed (carpeted space)? Confirm with Highland Rentals.

NOTES TO SELF (short)
- Combine all receipts into single ZIP named: edn-receipts-<lastname>-20251009.zip before upload.
- Snap photo of every invoice and save to phone album "EDN receipts" (backup to Google Photos)
- If any vendor asks for PO: EV-2025-EDN-01 (check with finance)

AFTER ACTIONS (post-trip)
- Upload receipts + boarding passes to Concur & tag EVT-412
- Quick retro: 15-min call with Jordan + Priya within 3 days to capture ops notes
- Ship demo gear back via Courier (book pickup 10/06) and attach tracking to Concur expense

Random messy thoughts:
- Might be smarter to consolidate hotel nights on company card to reduce manual cc reconciliation.
- If local SIM costs >20GBP, consider portable hotspot from T-Mobile allocated to demo budget.
- Keep a printed small map of venue loading to hand to courier driver.

End of jotter — tidy into Confluence runbook once trip complete.
